Thanks for the quick reply, Maria — Nov 1 at 1:00 PM ET works for us. I’ve penciled that in and will send a calendar invite once we confirm internal attendees.

Quick notes on fallback rules (high level):
- Tiering: route first to primary model (higher quality), then to an optimized quantized variant if latency or capacity thresholds hit.
- Region failover: local region first, global pool fallback if regional SLOs are missed.
- Cost-aware routing: attempt cheaper quantized path for non-critical prompts (tagged in prework); escalate to full precision for high-importance prompts.
- Circuit-breaker: if sustained error rate > 5% or latency > 2x SLO, automatically divert to safe-mode variant and notify ops.

I’ll attach a short fallback rules summary to the invite. We recommend a 90-minute block: 60 minutes hands-on + 30 minutes ops/next-steps OR split into 60/30 across two adjacent slots if your ops team prefers a separate run.

Ben / Marissa — can you confirm availability for Mon Nov 1 1:00 PM ET? If either of you prefers to split the session we’ll propose a second follow-up slot for the ops run.

Best,
Rohan
